about_the_game:
THE FIREFIGHT FOR OUR LIVES

Wildfires are tearing across our planet, fueled not just by climate collapse but by something far darker. A greed-driven energy experiment has fractured the boundary between worlds, opening portals to realms of demons, spirits, and mythological beasts. Fire is no longer just a force of nature. It’s alive.

APOCALYPSE IS NOW

Amidst the chaos of 2035, Fire Fight Labs emerges as the global leader in the war on fire. From its headquarters in Hope, Canada, and led by Dr. Daunis Zaagaasikwe, the world-renowned Anishinaabeg biochemist, Fire Fight Labs retrofits the most potent war machines to combat apocalyptic wildfires.

FIGHT LIKE A HERO, WIN AS A TEAM

Enter you and your crew: elite wildland firefighters turned heroes, humanity’s last line of defence. Team up with friends to form a hotshot crew of four specialized roles: Crew Chief, Assault, Medic, Engineer, each with unique skills, weapons, and tools crafted to win the war on fire.

COLLECTIVE ACTION vs EXISTENTIAL THREAT

Armed with the latest wildfire innovations, futuristic gear crafted from adapted military tech, and the revolutionary fire suppressant BLÜME, your mission is to save lives, defend ecosystems, and defeat the infernal forces threatening our world.

A GLOBAL ADVENTURE

Traverse our planet, face firestorms born of legend, battle zombie fires raging year-round, rescue lions stuck in burning sycamore trees, save civilians and wildlife, defend towns, infrastructure, sacred and cursed lands. Fight shoulder to shoulder with your crew to reclaim humanity's future.

FIRE FEATURES:

  • One to four player class-based co-op

  • Physics-driven wildfires on a massive scale

  • Jetpack locomotion and weaponized fire suppressants

  • Battle otherworldly demons and mythical beasts from the lore of the land

  • Fixed-wing and rotary air support

  • Droids, drones, and rugged wildland firefighting vehicles

  • Collect rare resources to craft the best weapons, armour, and gear

  • Upgrade your Firebase to unlock capabilities and equipment

  • Play fetch with your dog =)

YOU WIN BY SAVING. THIS GAME IS FIRE.

name: FIRE

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card (with surround sound support preferred)

short_description: Battle raging wildfires and mythical beasts across massive worlds in FIRE: a co-op action shooter where 1 to 4 players must save our near-future Earth.
